x: The Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellowship is a DBT (Department of Biotechnology) scheme for Indian life-science and biotech scientists abroad who return, so it is the odd one out. INSPIRE, Vigyan Jyoti and the Nano Mission are DST schemes.

SERB-POWER (now under ANRF) gives research grants and fellowships to women researchers in academic and R&D institutions. The others are mismatched: BioCARe (DBT) supports women biotech scientists after a career break, GATI is the institutional gender-equity charter, and Vigyan Jyoti is for girl students of Classes 9-12.
